title: Blank cells remain blank after a step
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine with Boolean work-tape symbols, let $x$ be a finite Boolean input, and let $c$ be a configuration of $M$ on input $x$. Suppose that for some natural number $s$, every work-tape head of $c$ is at an integer position of absolute value at most $s$, and every work-tape cell at an integer position of absolute value greater than $s$ is blank. Then, after one step of $M$ from $c$, every work-tape cell at an integer position of absolute value greater than $s$ is blank.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine with Boolean symbols
$c$ is a configuration of $M$ on input $x$
All work-tape head positions in $c$ have absolute value at most $s$
All work-tape cells in $c$ outside the interval $[-s,s]$ are blank
